main_text.l: momenti res, recessuum cordis expurgatio. Multum er-
go de his queritur Al Gazalius qui de exteriori corpo-
ris munditie ad superstitionē usq; folliciti sint, adeo
ut illos qui minus hac ex parte superstitiosi sint pro
immundis habeant, & eorum contactum fugiant;
cùm interim sit apud ipsos الباطن
خراب وسخون quod intus est, desolatum, & oppletum vitiis superbiæ,
fastus, ignorantia, dissimulationis & hypocrisis, rerum
ordine penitus inverso.
Antiquior tamen apud A-
rabes mundandi corporis cura Mohammedanismo vi-
detur, cuius ritus (ab Abrahamo, ut volunt, accep-
tos) ad decem capita reducit Al Sharestanius (alios
quos vidit authores secutus) quorum quinque ad ca-
put, quinque ad reliquas corporis partes pertineant:
quae ad caput, sunt المضمضة Gargarizatio, seu ofis
collutio, 2 الاستنشاق Narium aquâ inspirata purgatio. 3 قص الشارب Mystacis
tonsura. 4 الفرق Capillorum discriminatio. 5 السواك Dentium fricatio quae
ad reliquum corpus الاستحداد Mundatio ab excremen-
tis emissis, تقليم الاظفار Unguium praefectio, نتف الابط
Pilorum axillarium vulsio, حلق العانة Rasura
pubis, الختان Circumcisio, quae (inquit)
tus conversa confirmavit; qui ipsissimi sunt quos
à Mohammede suis commendatos refert Al Gazalius,
nisi quòd duodecim recenseat, ac ita partiatur, ut
quinque (prædicti nempe isti) caput spectent; tres,
manus & pedes, nempe unguium præfectio, ablutio
البراجم i. e. articulorum digitalium, & mundatio الرواجب

page.notes: <note side="right">Hac primum fecisse Abrahamum, refert Al Jannab. in vit. Abrah.</note> Arabic words are transcribed without vowel marks, as printed. Uncertain Arabic readings, including the Arabic words at the start of the catchword line, were not marked with [?] because the scan is small; they should be checked against the page image. The marginal note is placed beside the "Mundatio ab excrementis" line, which is where it stands on the page. The inline numerals 2–5 are printed in the text and kept as they stand. The catchword line reads الرواجب at the right below the last line. The paragraph break before "Antiquior" is a printed indent mid-line.
